heading: TTL sweep
text:
### TTL sweep [IRET.19.3]

The engine must sweep expired facts once per pump, against the pump's
monotonic sample `now_ns` ([LTIM.2.8.2]), before any activation fires
([IRET.19.4]):

1. Iterate all live facts with `deadline_ns > 0`.
2. For each fact where `now_ns >= deadline_ns`: call
   `ds_rete_wm_retract`. The retraction cascades through
   the Rete network and may enqueue new activations on the
   agenda (rules that fire on absence of the expired fact).
3. Continue until all expired facts are retracted.

The order in which expired facts are retracted is [LDTL.6.1] and [LDTL.6.2]'s.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__idle_net
idris.note: A clocked network with no deadline and no row. A fixture.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__sweep_net_sub
idris.note: The TTL sweep only removes: the expired ids' retraction and the cascade.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__expired_fact_cannot_reopen
idris.note: The sweep retracts the expired `Ping` at the tick to 2, before the re-time: the window opens at 3 on nothing. `[1, 0, 0, 0]`, computed.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep_net_view
idris.note: The TTL sweep's retractions keep the view.

idris.name: iret_12_2__retract_ids_net_unfired
idris.note: The sweep's retractions, one expired fact at a time, fire nothing.

idris.name: iret_19_3__clocked_net_eta
idris.note: The clocked engine is its engine, its deadline table and its clock.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__ticked_fires_once_ttl
idris.note: After the clause's sweep A has one match, the surviving fact's, and fires once for it. Read off the literal.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__ticked_ready_ttl
idris.note: The clause's sweep executed: the fact whose deadline is at the clock is retracted at the tick, the one whose deadline is ahead stays; the tick before, with every deadline ahead, retracted nothing. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__ttl_two
idris.note: A kind with a TTL, so that the clause's sweep has a deadline to act on. A fixture.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep_net_inv
idris.note: The clause's sweep at a pump, retracting each expired fact and cascading, keeps the invariant.

idris.name: rdsc_4a_5__load_clocked
idris.note: The clocked engine at load: no deadlines, the clock at the start.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__swept_ready_ttl
idris.note: The clocked network after a sweep: the deadline table keeps the swept row, the clock at the tick's sample. Computed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__ttl_one
idris.note: A TTL of 1 on kind 0: the deadline is the clock at the assert plus one. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__tick_timed
idris.note: The sweep against the sample, at the tick. LESS than the clause's 'once per pump' as `ltim_2_8_4__tick_timed`'s RARC.5.6.3 note says.

idris.name: rtim_3_2_6__one_move_timed
idris.note: The two expiries swept at the tick whose sample passes both deadlines. Executed. LESS than the clause: the sweep's placement is this model's.

idris.name: Iret_19_3__clocked_net
idris.note: The network engine with truth maintenance, its deadline table and its clock.

idris.name: iret_19_3__clocked_net_eq
idris.note: Clocked network states with equal parts are equal.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__retract_order
idris.note: BOTH SIDES EXPIRE THE SAME FACTS: retracting the expired ids in [LDTL.6.1]'s order removes exactly what Rete/TtlSweep.idr's batch removes. The order is visible only in the sequence of retractions -- the FACT_RETRACT events of [NFCT.5.4] -- since any order ends in the same state.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep_net
idris.note: THE SWEEP ON THE NETWORK: every live fact whose deadline is at or before the clock retracted one at a time through alpha dispatch -- [IRET.19.3] step 2, `ds_rete_wm_retract` per fact -- in [LDTL.6.1]'s order, then the cascade.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__sweep_agree
idris.note: THE SWEEP AGREES: the network's retractions one at a time in [LDTL.6.1]'s order and FireLoop's batch end in one working memory, and the cascades after them agree.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__transfer_ttl
idris.note: THE TRANSFER WITH TICKS: a canonical replay with ticks from FireLoop's empty state is one from the loaded network, and at its end the two agree. Rete/TtlSweep.idr's theorems are theorems of the network.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__expired_fact_cannot_reopen_timed
idris.note: A fact whose deadline is at or before the clock is swept at the tick, before the pump that would have re-timed its chain (this model's placement; the two coincide at the pump boundary). Executed.

idris.name: Iret_19_3__clocked
idris.note: The engine with truth maintenance, its deadline table, and its clock RARC.5.5.

idris.name: Iret_19_3__inv
idris.note: The clocked state's invariant: the engine's run invariant and target kinds of Rete/TmsRun.idr and Lcyc/TmsTermination.idr, and the deadline table's well-formedness at the current clock.

idris.name: iret_19_3__expired
idris.note: The clause's step 1 and its test: the ids whose deadline is at or before now (`now_ns >= deadline_ns`); a fact without a row is never expired.

idris.name: iret_19_3__sweep_cascade
idris.note: The sweep's cascade is an external change in Rete/PumpBoundary.idr's sense: the engine's invariants hold after it, the facts only shrink, and every explicit-kind survivor of the retraction is kept.

idris.name: lfst_9_2_1__canonical_ttl_from_input
idris.note: With the sweep at every boundary -- this model's placement, as each input is consumed; the clause's is the pump's entry (RARC.5.6.3) -- a certified positive program replays any canonical stream with ticks from any input with unique ids, every pump quiescent, the clocked invariant at every boundary.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep
idris.note: THE SWEEP, the clause's steps 2 and 3: retract every live fact whose deadline is at or before the clock, propagate, and run the cascade the ended activations demand. One batch retracts them all: the deadlines are decided by the clock the sweep reads, and a retraction creates no new deadline, so the clause's loop to a fixpoint is one pass. Where it runs is `rarc_5_6_3__prepare`'s: as each input is consumed, where the clause runs it once per pump at the pump's entry (RARC.5.6.3). The sweep itself is the clause's; its placement is that tie's `partial`.
